h1: Mobile Tire Service in West Palm Beach
intro: Mobile tire service in West Palm Beach is the van from Los Paisas Tires Shop, not a second storefront. The shop itself stays at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. If the car should stay put, we can come to you when the address is within 10 miles of that shop. Call +1 561-429-4041 and we confirm the spot before anyone leaves.

The van runs during shop hours: 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, seven days a week, including Sunday. If the tire will hold air and you can drive, the bay is usually the better place, especially if you want to look through used tires or put the car on the alignment rack.

sections.heading: What a mobile visit can include
paragraphs: On a mobile stop we can repair a puncture when it is safe to repair, change a tire that is already with you, or mount tires you have on site if the place is safe to work. Tell us the tire size when you call. If you need a used or new tire brought out, we only promise that when we have confirmed the size and that we actually have it. We will not pretend the van carries the whole shop.

Alignment is not a driveway service. The geometry equipment stays at 1114 S Military Trl. Balancing that needs the shop machine stays there too. A flat tire, a mount you cannot drive in for, or a spare that will not get you here are the reasons to use the van.

sections.heading: How to ask for the van
paragraphs: Call or WhatsApp +1 561-429-4041. Give the address, the vehicle, and what failed. Say whether you have a spare, and whether the car is in a driveway, a lot, or on the shoulder. If the place is not safe, we will ask you to get the car to the shop instead of working in traffic.
We quote the work before we commit to the drive. There is no price list on this page. Hours are the shop hours. A call at night does not create a 24-hour promise. English or Spanish, same number.

sections.heading: Towns inside the 10-mile area
paragraphs: Greenacres, Palm Springs, and Lake Worth Beach are inside the 10-mile area around 1114 S Military Trl. We checked those town boundaries against the shop, and the towns themselves sit inside that radius, so you can ask for the van there. We still confirm the actual address, because a job site has to be a place we can work. We do not publish drive minutes.

West Palm Beach is the shop city. If you are farther out, ask. If you are outside 10 miles, the answer is to come to the shop, not to stretch the van. Separate notes for Greenacres, Lake Worth Beach, and Palm Springs are linked below. They are mobile pages, not copies of every service.

faqs.question: How far do you go?
faqs.answer: Within 10 miles of 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. Call with the address and we will confirm it before we roll.

faqs.question: Do you align the car in my driveway?
faqs.answer: No. Alignment stays at the shop. Mobile service is tire work: a flat, a mount, or a tire we already agreed to bring.

faqs.question: Are you a 24-hour roadside service?
faqs.answer: No. The van works the same hours as the shop, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, seven days. Call during those hours.
